clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, Calor directs efforts to defend Duskwood from worgen. Under Jonathan Carevin, he helps the Carevin family hunt the beasts stalking the forests.

In Darkshire, Calor supports the Carevin family's fight against the terrors closing in on town. He works with Jonathan Carevin, one of Darkshire's defenders, to eradicate the supernatural horrors before the remaining townsfolk are slaughtered.

Calor sends fighters after the worgen prowling Duskwood, especially near the Rotting Orchard. These ferocious wolf-men are more dangerous than common beasts, and they slaughter travelers and patrols alike. Calor calls on capable fighters to thin their ranks and investigate their origins, hoping to stem their attacks.
